children: Paraguay’s Consumer Confidence Index fell 3.32 points to 39.67 in August 2026 from July, marking its lowest reading since May.
The Economic Situation Index decreased to 29.92 from 32.42, while the Economic Expectations Index fell to 49.42 from 53.55.
Meanwhile, consumers’ willingness to purchase durable goods declined, as did their assessment of saving possibilities.

title: Paraguay Consumer Confidence Hits Three-Month Low
